findings.current: At the center of that tremendous clash, which had swallowed up an area dozens of *jang* across, Jeok Cheongang stood between the Blood-Sword Demon Lord and me, who’d been frozen like a statue.
findings.defect: Omits Jeok Cheongang pushing the frozen narrator away before stopping the Blood-Sword Demon Lord.
findings.rationale: 밀어 내고 and 막아선 specify both actions and their order.
findings.replacement: At the center of that tremendous clash, which had swallowed an area dozens of *jang* across, Jeok Cheongang had shoved me aside when I froze like a statue and stepped in to stop the Blood-Sword Demon Lord.
findings.source: 반경 수십여 장에 달하는 공간을 단숨에 집어삼킨 강대한 격돌의 중심에는, 석상처럼 굳어 있던 나를 밀어 내고 혈검마군을 막아선 적천강이 있었다.

findings.current: Beneath a hundred mountains of sabers and forests of swords, aimed at countless enemies as if held by an invisible hand.
findings.defect: Makes the hundred summoned weapons into a hundred mountains and forests.
findings.rationale: 일백 개 counts the weapons forming the figurative 도산검림, not one hundred mountains.
findings.replacement: Beneath a mountain of sabers and a forest of swords—a hundred blades aimed at countless enemies as if held by an invisible hand.
findings.source: 마치 보이지 않는 손에 붙잡힌 듯, 무수한 적들을 향해 겨누어진 일백 개의 도산검림(刀山劍林) 아래에서.

findings.current: I realized that time was finally flowing again, and that a streak of light had torn through the gap like a bolt of lightning.
findings.defect: Drops the fact that the streak of light was swung—an attack, not merely light moving through a gap.
findings.replacement: Only then did I realize that time had begun flowing again—and that a streak of light had been swung like lightning through the gap.
findings.source: 이제야 다시 흐르기 시작하는 현실의 시간과, 그 틈새를 찢으며 벼락처럼 휘둘려진 한 줄기의 섬광을 깨달으며.

findings.defect: Calls a single English word “two words.”
findings.rationale: 두 글자 refers to the two Korean characters of 마법; the English rendering is one word.

findings.current: A chill ran through me as hundreds of pieces of steel slid against one another.
findings.defect: Adds a physical reaction and loses the cold, ringing sound of the steel.
findings.rationale: 서늘한 describes the sound; the source does not say a chill runs through the narrator.
findings.replacement: The cold ring of hundreds of pieces of steel sliding against one another.
findings.source: 수백에 달하는 무수한 강철이 맞물리며 울려 퍼지는 서늘한 소음을.

summary: The draft omits Jeok Cheongang’s rescue action and turns a hundred summoned weapons into a hundred mountains of weapons.
